## Key Projects

### 1. Yellow (`yellow`)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ARYAN-04/yellow
- **Tech**: Go, TypeScript, SQLite
- **Description**: Lightweight tournament and bracket management engine with deterministic pairing algorithms and admin middleware authorization.

### 2. FIFA Watch-Along (`fifa-watch-along`)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ARYAN-04/fifa-watch-along
- **Tech**: Python, TypeScript, Machine Learning, NLP
- **Description**: Real-time match telemetry stream and watch-along platform with trained sentiment and time-decay prediction models.

### 3. Aviation Load Factor Analysis (`aviation-load-factor-analysis`)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ARYAN-04/aviation-load-factor-analysis
- **Tech**: Python, Jupyter, Pandas, Streamlit
- **Description**: Predictive modeling and analytics dashboard exploring airline seat occupancy factors and route optimization metrics.

### 4. Health Monitor Daemon (`health_monitor_daemon_project`)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ARYAN-04/health_monitor_daemon_project
- **Tech**: Python, Linux Systemd, Shell
- **Description**: Background monitoring service tracking real-time server telemetry, memory, and CPU metrics with automated alerting.

### 5. Stock Pricer LSTM (`stock_pricer_LSTM`)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ARYAN-04/stock_pricer_LSTM
- **Tech**: Python, TensorFlow, LSTM Neural Networks
- **Description**: Deep learning sequential model predicting historical stock price trajectories using Long Short-Term Memory architectures.
